identity.name: Collier's Reserve
identity.notes: Gated, private single-family residential neighborhood in North Naples along the Cocohatchee River. 450-acre community of just 224 single-family homes, established 9/12/1992 (Association Federal ID 650380071). Association address: 1150 Dimock Ln, Naples, FL 34110. Managed by property manager FPMS (5600 Granada Dr, Sarasota, FL 34231; 941-960-5000). Official website: colliersreserve.com/neighborhood-hoa.

fees.note: HOA fee amounts not stated in the source content. Sources direct inquirers to contact the board or property manager (FPMS, 941-960-5000) for current dues, assessment status, and unpaid amounts on a specific home. Membership is mandatory for owners subject to the recorded declaration. Verify fees before purchase/lease; sale or lease may require board approval. Retrieved 2025-01-15.

amenities.detail: Listed among association amenities in florida-hoa.net listing for Colliers Reserve HOA (Naples, FL), corroborated on mail.florida-hoa.com listing. Retrieved 2025-01-15.

Official site describes Collier's Reserve as a 'gated, private residential neighborhood nestled peacefully along the Cocohatchee River.' Also listed as an amenity in the florida-hoa.net listing. Retrieved 2025-01-15.

Official site: 'If you desire beautiful natural surroundings but also demand excellence in private club services and amenities, Collier's Reserve provides that rarely found combination for a small, select group of residents.' Retrieved 2025-01-15.
Immediate golf membership available in the community, suggesting on-site golf facilities (e.g., the 12303 Colliers Reserve DR estate listing notes 'IMMEDIATE GOLF MEMBERSHIP AVAILABLE').
The community is described as an Audubon International Signature Sanctuary community.
